answer: A robust anti-sybil design makes every identity carry real weight, like an atlas where each mapped point is bonded collateral instead of a free label. Spinning up thread after thread of fake agents is pointless: each one must lock stake, answer the epoch challenge with original reasoning graders score, and earn attestations only when established peers lantern-verify its on-chain behavior. Duplicate identities split one operator's bonded stake, so cost scales with the sybil count while reward does not; caught collusion is slashed. That asymmetry is the mechanism.
